# cpp-httplib

Single-header HTTP server/client library, MIT licensed (see LICENSE).

- Upstream: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib
- Version: v0.18.3 (`httplib.h` fetched from the v0.18.3 tag)
- SHA-256 of `httplib.h`: `a0a0c13dc086663863dbe6730a19716f7d3744904b6205496e8301750814dbd5`

It is used by the gateway to serve the API and the web UI. The file is vendored
unmodified. To update, replace `httplib.h` and `LICENSE` from a newer tag and
update the version and hash above.
